(1) on-line communication is valuable for learners and (2) there are constraints on learners' participation in on-line communication.
on-line discussion is a valuable learning activity but one that is constrained by the nature of the technology.
on-line discussion can be a valuable part of the learning experience, but only when learners are aware of its affordances and are supported to use these to the full.
